caption: The drawing shows a detailed technical diagram of a chair in black ink on a beige background. The diagram includes three main views: a front elevation (center left), a side elevation (right), and a partial view of a carved chair back component (top left). The front elevation view displays ornate details such as a shell-shaped carving at the top, elaborate scrollwork in the backrest, and intricate patterns on one of the front legs. Both armrests are shown with curved and scroll-like ends. The side view illustrates the chair’s curved back and armrest in profile, the seat, and slightly cabriole-shaped front legs. Surrounding each chair view, precise measurement lines in red ink indicate multiple dimensions in inches and feet, corresponding to specific points and lengths on the chair. Boxes and guidelines in red ink overlay the views to help map and scale the components. At the bottom right corner, the text “SCALE 1 ½ IN. TO 1 FT.” is present, indicating the scale used in the drawing. The entire diagram is presented on a mildly aged, slightly yellowed, and textured piece of paper.
title: Chair
